title: Melinda normalized error
description: Normalized error payload returned by Melinda tools.

ok.description: Always false for an error payload.

code.description: Canonical machine-readable error code from ERROR_CONTRACT.

retryable.description: Whether the same request may be retried.

safe_user_message.description: User-facing message: what happened and the next safe option, without blaming the user or exposing internals.

handoff_recommended.description: Whether a human handoff is recommended.

correlation_id.description: Identifier linking the error to server-side audit and traces.

governance.validated_by: dr. Ferdi Andriska, S.H., M.Kn., CMDC
